params.body:
Step 3a of removing the Sanity layer. The data is plain since #232 and the `plain-ids` run (84,123 values rewritten on 2026-09-29, 0 left). This removes the code that existed only because it might not be.

## Ids are plain strings, in and out
- Writers build plain lists: `suggest`, `consolidate`, `enrich` no longer wrap ids as `{_type: 'reference', _ref, _key}`.
- The store refuses the old shape. `idsToStore()` throws on anything but a non-empty string, so a caller still speaking it fails in the tests instead of being dropped or stored again.
- Readers return plain ids.
  - `getPatterns().concepts`, `getRecentInsights().patterns/concepts/signalIds`, `supersedes`, and tension poles no longer re-wrap as `{_ref}`.
  - The dashboard's `pattern-detail` concepts are `{_id}` without `_ref`.
- One reader, `idList(json)`, replaces `refIds`, `unwrapRef`, `plainIds`, and nine hand-written `typeof x === 'string' ? x : x?._ref` copies. It also replaces the three SQL `CASE WHEN json_type = 'object' THEN json_extract('$._ref')` unwraps (concept lifecycle, pattern prune, insight concept counts) and the `SQL_REF` filters.
- `concept-fold` rewrites a list in one line now that it has one shape.
- `conceptId()` no longer accepts an object.

## Things that were never used
- `updateSignalConcepts` was a no-op. Enrich called it for every signal and printed the count as "Signals updated in Sanity".
- `relatedConcepts`, `opposingConcepts` and `evidenceSignals` were built by enrich and stored by nobody.

## The `/sanity/*` alias is gone
The dashboard (#60) and studio (#21) are live on `/store/*`; the bundles on the box were checked. The probe token's one POST is `/store/query` only.

## A bug found on the way: insights without a sector
Suggest collected an insight's sectors from `p.topics`, but store patterns carry `topicTags`. Since 2026-09-12 every insight it wrote went to the desk with no sector: 212, twelve a day, all drafts (none published).
- Fixed in `suggest.mjs`.
- `bin/insight-sectors.mjs` gives those insights the union of their own patterns' sectors, the rule the fixed writer applies. It is a dry run by default; `--apply` works in one transaction with the previous values in `insight_sectors_undo`, and `--undo` puts them back. Tested.

`bin/plain-ids.mjs` keeps its own small unwrap so `--undo` can still run; it goes with `plain_ids_undo` after a week.

Tests: 953 pass. Fixtures that wrote `{_ref}` now write plain ids; tests that proved "both shapes work" now prove the old shape is refused. Lint: 0 undefined names.

Merge together with gentells-dashboard (ids through one helper) and gentells-site (the `_ref` fallback), linked below once proposed.
params.title: Ids are plain in and out of the store; sectors back on new insights
